design_brief_zh: 主卖点是TSA密码锁便于海关人员进行更高效的行李查验，购买理由由“查验便利”延伸到“箱内有序”；不宣称快速通关、海关认可或绝对安全。PC画布1464×600采用左文右产品：左侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8]，按标题、支持说明、证据/细节1、证据/细节2纵向排列；右侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]，展示YWJ 13A旅行行李箱三分之四正面角度，箱体闭合，清楚呈现TSA锁、铝合金框架、竖条纹表面和四个防撞角，并用右侧局部开箱细节展示涤纶内衬、双区分隔及X型固定带。移动端1200×900采用上方产品与旅行查验场景区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]、底部文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，顺序仍为标题→支持说明→两条证据，底部为德语预留约20%扩展空间。标题对应TSA锁；支持说明对应海关查验便利；细节1对应涤纶内衬和双区分隔；细节2对应X型固定带。使用低饱和中性色背景、自然侧光和柔和阴影，突出PC/ABS箱体、铝合金边框与四角防护；以品牌蓝#01447B为主、橙色#E5641E少量强调锁具和分隔线。采用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题和TSA字样清晰易读；低调放置随附YWJ Logo，与其他A+模块保持连屏海报风格。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的TSA密码锁、便于海关人员查验、涤纶内衬、双区分隔和X型固定带事实；不得暗示海关认可、保证快速通关、绝对安全或任何未提供的认证、测试和性能。不得添加竞品商标、价格、促销、虚构评分或未提供的尺寸信息。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ split-layout travel photography banner for YWJ model 13A suitcase, with no rendered text or typography in the image. PC composition: left 38% clean reserved copy area with generous negative space; right 46% product area showing a closed suitcase in three-quarter front view. Clearly show the TSA combination lock, aluminium frame, vertical ridged shell, and four protective corner guards. Add a tasteful inset or open-lid detail revealing polyester lining, two separate compartments, and X-shaped packing straps. Keep the suitcase dominant and realistic, with subtle YWJ logo placement only if the supplied logo asset is available. Mobile composition: product and customs-inspection travel scene in the upper 53%, reserved clean copy area across the lower 31%; maintain the same visual hierarchy. Use low-saturation European modern travel photography, neutral background, natural side lighting, soft shadows, restrained brand blue #01447B with small orange #E5641E accents, premium durable PC/ABS shell and aluminium frame detail, coherent connected-banner styling. Do not add prices, badges, certifications, claims, competitor marks, or any rendered text.
